patterns.note: Full-bleed dark background with a central, persistent 3D model that acts as the primary visual anchor for content sections, with text blocks positioned around the model.
Large, outlined, uppercase display headings (Druk) create a strong, futuristic brand identity, contrasted with clean, legible sans-serif body text (Montserrat).
A high-contrast palette of deep charcoal/black, pure white, and a vibrant light blue/cyan accent color, used sparingly to highlight key elements and the 3D model.

A continuous, scroll-driven 3D animation of an aircraft model, where scrolling reveals different perspectives, internal views, or highlights specific features of the model, synchronized with the appearance of descriptive text sections.
Content is structured around the persistent 3D model, with text blocks appearing adjacent to the model to describe its features and vision, creating a guided narrative experience.

technique_notes: A full-screen WebGL/Three.js canvas is used to render a detailed 3D model of an aircraft. Scroll position drives camera movement, model rotation, and potentially material changes or internal reveals within the 3D scene, creating a continuous, interactive product showcase.

Text content sections are positioned over the 3D canvas and are revealed with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as their corresponding scroll triggers are met, ensuring they appear in sync with the 3D model's narrative progression.
The primary navigation bar appears after an initial scroll threshold and then remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, outlined display headings (~5-8x body) with a strong, bold character, paired with a clean, well-spaced sans-serif for body text and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with minimal to no visible corner rounding on UI elements or content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and open, particularly in the hero and 3D model sections, creating a sense of grandeur and focus on the central visual. Content blocks have generous vertical spacing.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its immersive, scroll-driven 3D model interaction, which serves as the central narrative device. Instead of static images or videos, the product is continuously showcased and explored in a dynamic WebGL environment, making the user experience highly engaging and memorable.
